headline: Material Handler
education: Master's Degree in Computer Science (in progress)
summary: This candidate brings experience in material handling, food service, and general labor, including nine years of material handling experience with forklift, scanning/barcode, boom truck, and pallet jack skills. The candidate also has a background in food preparation and general labor assignments. The candidate is detail-oriented, physically capable, and comfortable working independently or as part of a team. The candidate is pursuing a graduate-level education in computer science while seeking part-time, first-shift opportunities in office and professional settings.
